scope: All official club competitions captured; competitions and clubs remain separate. Norwegian league uses calendar season 2026. No friendlies, youth national-team games, live or future matches.
coverageNotice: Coverage is not certified exhaustive. coveredTotals sum the approved available competition buckets; gaps and conflicting sources keep totals null. A zero from a verified club catalogue is explicitly limited to that club catalogue.
